texts: The longest known unbeaten streak in professional football belongs to the AC Milan team, which went 49 games without a loss from May 1991 to March 1993. This impressive run includes all competitive matches, and it stands as a testament to the team's exceptional defensive capabilities and tactical discipline under their coach during that period.

The longest known unbeaten streak in professional football belongs to the New England Patriots, who went 35 games without a loss between 2003 and 2004. This impressive run includes both regular season and playoff games, showcasing the team's dominance during that period.

The longest known unbeaten streak in professional football is held by the New Zealand national team, the All Whites, who went 58 consecutive matches without a loss from 1936 to 1958. This streak included multiple international friendlies as well as regional tournaments in the Pacific. This record stands out in international football history for its length and the level of competition faced over two decades.

The longest known unbeaten streak in professional football is held by ASEC Mimosas, a club from Côte d'Ivoire. They went 108 matches unbeaten in the Ivorian league from 1989 to 1994. This remarkable streak is recognized as the longest in top-flight football history.
